summary: Round aluminum mounting hub, a short disc with a central bore for a 3 mm motor shaft, four axial mounting holes on a bolt circle, and one radial set-screw hole in the rim. The set includes two hubs, but only one hub is modeled.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat outer face with the four mounting holes, for attaching a wheel or mechanism
Flat face toward the motor, with the shaft bore

notes: The listing gives only the 3 mm shaft diameter. Hub diameter (about 20 mm), thickness (about 6 mm), bolt-circle radius (about 7 mm, at 45° positions) and hole sizes are rough estimates from the photos, scaled against the gearmotor. The bore is set to the 3 mm shaft size. The four mounting holes are listed as M3-class holes at 3 mm nominal, not threaded. Their depth is not visible, so through is set to false. The set-screw hole depth is also unknown; it sits on the rim on the +y side. The two set screws and the Allen wrench are separate items and are not part of this model.
